ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flaky golden-brown pastry with a bubbly, lightly browned top edge, about 9 cm long by 5 cm wide, sitting at the upper center of the plate; its open-looking face shows a layer of pale cream-colored filling, a band of red-orange sauce, and a dark brown crumbly minced mixture with green flecks, slightly glossy and moist in appearance | 85
ITEM 2 | Cylindrical section of corn on the cob, about 5 cm long and 3.5 cm in diameter, with bright yellow kernels in tight rows showing a matte, slightly moist surface, one side cut flat with a pale white-cream exposed edge and a small patch of white residue on the lower left | 90
